title.narrative: Protect, safeguard, and promote natural and cultural and tangible heritage

description.narrative: In line with the recently submitted emergency nomination Dossier for Boma-Badingilo Migratory Landscape for inclusion on the World Heritage list in Feb 2026, UNESCO South Sudan Office will support and accompany the commitment of the national authorities to pursue its world heritage agenda to inscribe Boma-Badingilo Migratory Landscape as heritage in danger list. The office will support the State Party of South Sudan in community consultation to allow the participation, engage and involve all the community stakeholders in the landscape to obtain free, prior and informed consent. The Office will support nominations, updating of tentative lists and improvement of management and conservation of the sites in South Sudan as well as the development extra budgetary projects to support the initiatives. This is also in line with the ongoing development of inventory for the ICH elements in South Sudan and the recent nomination of an element to representative list of UNESCO for consideration, the office will also support working with the national authorities, communities and the implementing partner to expedite the implementation and development list of ICH elements for South Sudan.
